concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-reconciliation-use-cases-verify-balances]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace worked guide to daily account/currency balance snapshots, value-dated Accounting Report Balance (PC) sums, and conditional negative-balance compensation/warning evidence; warning sample timestamps conflict with stated thresholds.
warnings: The 2024-10-19 negativeBalanceSince to 2024-10-22 warning creation is only three days despite stated default 20-day warning; scheduled 2024-12-01 timing does not establish an exact 30-day compensation interval.
Historical report positions and configured warning/top-up routes do not prove current available funds, completed internal compensation, external payout or bank receipt.
